usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Height receives a task when “Order Paid” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in Height
bestTemplate.why: A paid order becomes a Height task, so fulfilment work starts without anyone copying the order over.

watchOut: “Create Task” adds to one Height workspace, so pick the workspace your fulfilment team watches.
